WITH tallies AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), 'Missing') AS hand,
         COUNT(*) AS tally
  FROM manager_award m
  JOIN player p ON p.player_id = m.player_id
  GROUP BY 1
),
shares AS (
  SELECT hand, tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
  FROM tallies
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares
),
above AS (
  SELECT s.hand, s.tally, s.share
  FROM shares s, avg_share a
  WHERE s.share > a.avg_s
)
SELECT SUM(above.tally) AS combined_tally,
       AVG(above.share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(above.share - a.avg_s) AS avg_excess_over_average
FROM above, avg_share a;
